findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: demo.generateSnippet · Private data: install.getSnippet, demo.generateSnippet, help.startSignup, help.explainTokenSetup, help.authStatus · Public sink: help.startSignup · Destructive: install.getSnippet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: demo.generateSnippet · Private data: install.getSnippet, demo.generateSnippet, help.startSignup, help.explainTokenSetup, help.authStatus · Public sink: help.startSignup · Destructive: install.getSnippet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
